server.title: Server
server.intro: Is the background work running? Stock coming in from the ERP, expired cart holds, documents to the ERP and the daily checks all run here, away from the shop's pages.

ok.title: Background work is running
ok.text: The worker said "I am alive" in the last {seconds} seconds.

stale.title: Background work has stopped answering
stale.text: No sign of life for more than {seconds} seconds. Stock, cart holds and ERP documents wait until it is back. The server restarts it by itself; if this stays, tell the developer.

stopped.title: Background work is switched off
stopped.text: The worker was stopped on purpose (an update or a restart). It starts again with the next update.

never.title: Background work has not started yet
never.text: No worker has run on this server yet. It starts with the next update of the site.

kpi.retryingSub: Each waits a little longer before the next try

failed.title: Jobs that failed
failed.sub: The last {hours} hours. A job that worked on a later try is not listed.
failed.dead: It will not be tried again by itself.

jobs.orders_pii_purge: Clearing kept IP, device and location
jobs.courier_track: Reading parcel updates from the couriers
jobs.courier_zones: Reading and pairing the couriers' area lists
jobs.packing_photos_expire: Archiving packing photos past their days to keep

workers.title: Workers
workers.sub: Each copy of the background worker and its last sign of life. Only one plans the jobs at a time (the leader).
workers.empty: No worker in the last {hours} hours.

server.note: This page only shows; it changes nothing. Memory, disks, cache and alerts come to this page with their own steps.

errors.WORKER_LOST: The worker stopped in the middle of this job; it runs again.
errors.STALLED: The job got stuck too many times and was given up.
